title: fix(app-shell): on a phone, a record-drawer link that carries a related-record form opens that form over the record page

## 维护者速读

- 改了什么：手机上打开（或刷新）「记录侧栏 + 新建关联记录表单」链接时，跳转到记录页会带上 `form`、`formObject`、`formLink` 三个表单参数（以及该历史条目里的预填值），表单留在记录页上；返回列表的地址不再带表单参数。
- 为什么改：手机不画侧栏，会把列表地址换成记录页地址，换的时候只保留了来源列表，表单参数丢了，表单闪一下就关，用户停在没有表单的记录页上。
- 风险与回滚：只改 `@object-ui/app-shell` 的手机跳转一处；不带表单参数的链接、桌面端行为都与原来完全一样（有对照测试）。回滚即 revert。
- 先看：① `ui/packages/app-shell/src/views/objectViewRecordNavigation.ts` 的 `handleNavOverlayNavigate`（`movesForm` 那段）；② `objectViewRecordNavigation.phonePush-29074.test.tsx` 新增的 objectstack#32750 一节。
- 两分钟验证：`pnpm --dir ui exec vitest run packages/app-shell/src/views/objectViewRecordNavigation.phonePush-29074.test.tsx`，预期 12 条全过，其中 5 条是本卡新增。
- 需要你做的：无，席位落地。

## What changes

On a phone the list answers a record-drawer link (`?recordId=`) with the record's page, in the list's place in the history (objectstack#27058). `handleNavOverlayNavigate` built that page URL with no search, so a link that also named a related-record form (`?recordId=…&form=new&formObject=…&formLink=…`) lost the form: `AppContent` opened it from the list URL and closed it once the redirect landed.

- The phone redirect (the `replace` navigation only the phone's drawer-link effect makes) now moves the record-form overlay's URL parameters onto the record page: `form`, `formObject`, `formLink` (the three `AppContent` reads, `urlParams.ts`), in the URL's order. The seeded create values the overlay reads from the history entry (`RECORD_FORM_CREATE_VALUES_STATE`, `readRecordFormCreateValues`) go along in the page's state when a form is carried.
- The list kept as the page's way back (`state.from`) drops the moved form parameters as well as `recordId`, so the page's 「‹」 returns to the list without reopening the form over it. This is one step past the order's suggested route ("`state.from` keeps today's list origin minus `recordId`"): left in, the way back would open a second copy of the form over the list.
- A drawer link with no form parameters, and every other navigation the handler makes (row taps, `↗`, `Open as full page`, desktop), are unchanged.

## Tests

- `ui/packages/app-shell/src/views/objectViewRecordNavigation.phonePush-29074.test.tsx`, new top-level describe "a phone carries the record form of a drawer link to the record page (objectstack#32750)": the redirect carries `form` / `formObject` / `formLink` and the origin keeps none of them nor `recordId`; the same under a view route (`../../record/…`); the seeded create values travel; CONTROL: a link with no form is answered with no search and the exact state as before; CONTROL: a desktop row click on a URL that names a form moves nothing.
- `ui/packages/app-shell/src/console/__tests__/AppContent.recordFormOverDrawer-32685.test.tsx`, new top-level describe for objectstack#32750: at phone width the real `AppContent` and `ModalForm`, at the URL the redirect writes, open the form over the record page and it is still open 800 ms later (no `onOpenChange(false)`); CONTROL: the record page with no form parameters draws no form.

## Acceptance notes

- The `AppContent`-level case is mounted at the record URL rather than driven through the redirect: in that harness a router transition from the list route to the record route never commits, measured at a desktop width too, so the redirect is pinned at the hook and the landing at `AppContent`. Under that harness's doubles the record route keeps re-rendering (the mocked record view renders a few hundred times a second at both widths), which is why those waits are plain timers rather than `act`; observed in the test doubles only, not measured in the running console.

- vitest over `packages/app-shell/src/views/` and `packages/app-shell/src/console/` on `5755b4ba` (before the one `main` merge, which touched none of the four files): exit 0.
- `@object-ui/app-shell` `type-check` (both programs) on `5755b4ba`: exit 0.

- `dispatch-gates --commands` on `5755b4ba`: 36 derived commands (including `node scripts/check-sdui-manifest.mjs`), each run, all exit 0; `--ran` reconciled 36 of 36, 0 NOT MEASURED.
- Ablation, one per behaviour, each restored to the HEAD blob (`git diff HEAD` empty):
  - `movesForm` forced to `false` turns the three carry cases red; the two CONTROLs stay green.
  - the origin built from the whole search turns the "origin keeps neither" case red.
  - the seeded-values spread removed turns the seeded case red.
- Browser, Playwright `iPhone 13`, `examples/app-crm` (`objectstack dev --fresh`) behind the Console's Vite dev server built from this branch:

<details><summary>Readings</summary>

- `/apps/crm_app/crm_account?recordId=<id>&form=new&formObject=crm_contact&formLink=account:<id>` lands on `/apps/com.example.crm/crm_account/record/<id>?form=new&formObject=crm_contact&formLink=account%3A<id>`; the "Create Contact" dialog is open 7.5 s after load with Account prefilled (`Initech`). `Esc` closes it and leaves `/record/<id>` with no search; the page's 「‹ Accounts」 then goes to `/apps/com.example.crm/crm_account` with no form.
- CONTROL, `/apps/crm_app/crm_account?recordId=<id>`: lands on `/record/<id>` with no search; no dialog.
- Same run with the fix ablated (`movesForm = false`, Vite reload): the form link lands on `/record/<id>` with no search and no dialog, the card's reading; restored afterwards to the HEAD blob.

</details>
